data.name: Sherwood
data.gender_notes: Sherwood is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English scir weorc, meaning ‘bright or shining work’ or ‘woodland clearing’. Sherwood refers to someone who lives or dwells in a bright or shining woodland clearing. The name Sherwood carries the meaning “Forest dweller” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Sherwood usually hope their child will grow to embody forest dweller and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A place of refuge and safety.
data.etymology: Sherwood belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Forest dweller.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sherwood total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sherwood gained significant cultural appeal through the legend of Robin Hood. In the story, Sherwood Forest serves as Robin Hood's hideout, and the name became associated with the spirit of resistance against injustice and oppression. This cultural narrative of standing up for the underdog or fighting against tyranny has continued to inspire and resonate with people throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, Sherwood can be seen as representing a safe haven or refuge in the midst of the challenges and hardships of life. This can be interpreted as a metaphor for the strength and support found in our faith and the community of believers. Just as Sherwood Forest was the hiding place for those in need, our faith and spiritual connections can provide us with a sense of peace, protection, and guidance in the midst of a chaotic world.
